text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas. Haru Urara, who loves fun events,
had been looking forward to it for a long time—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, it's almost Christmas!
I wanna have a party!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho... You know, on Christmas,
we eat a big carrot cake!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Hurry up and be Christmas already~.
Wait, should we just celebrate Christmas right now?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*... *gasp*!
I can't wait to see Santa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, as a reward for Haru Urara,
who's been working so hard lately...”

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wooww...! Whoa, whoaaa!
Amazing, amazing, it's a Christmas party!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you set this up?!
Amazing! It's so cute~!
choice_data_list: I'm holding onto some presents from Santa too.
I have presents from Santa to give you too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Amazing!
Thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You know, I'm really so happy! Can you feel my excitement shouting, "Hooray!"?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so glad!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer, you were friends with Santa Claus all along!
That's my Trainer for ya~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Bring them to the academy next time!
I want to properly say thank you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, right!
Guess what, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, Christmas is a fun day for everyone!
Not just for kids, but for adults too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, for my well-behaved Trainer,
here's a present from Santa Urara!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Haru Urara handed over was a colorful
booklet of 10 coupons, each labeled
"Good for One Favor."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Helping with spring cleaning, preparing meals, keeping you company for a chat—you name it, I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got!
Call me whenever you need me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you're happy, aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"You know, when I gave that ticket to my papa when I was little,
he was suuuuuper happy!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So I wanted Trainer to be just as happy as Papa was!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Papa treasures them so much that he tucked them all away safe and sound,
so he hasn't actually used a single one yet.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, don't just lock it away in a treasure chest, okay?
Make sure you put it to good use!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, what a great answer!
Well then, let's get the party started!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Haru Urara and I
spent a lively Christmas together.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I have a present for you too!
Though I can't give it to you today just yet...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"It's a super special, one-of-a-kind present!
Something I'm sure you'll love, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: What kind of present is it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~! Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: First place in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"It might be super hard, but...
I really want to give it to you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If you look forward to it, Trainer, I know I can do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"So, could you wait
just a little longer for my present?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
It's a promise, okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely, definitely
going to give it to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to Haru Urara's present,
we went on to spend a wonderful Christmas together.
